rules.name: HarvesterPips
rules.comment: Total number of pips to show when a harvester is selected by the player. The number of filled pips is dynamically determined based on the `MaxHarvesterCapacity` rule and the amount the tiberium onboard.

rules.name: CreditsPerTiberiumScoop
rules.comment: The value of one scoop of tiberium collected by a Harvester. Number of scoops is controlled by the `MaxHarvesterCapacity` rule, these two rules combined are multiplied together to calculate the value of a full harvester.

rules.name: MaxHarvesterCapacity
rules.comment: How much tiberium a harvester can hold, measured in the number of scoops a harvester makes. Value of a scoop is controlled by the `CreditsPerTiberiumScoop` rule, these two rules combined are multiplied together to calculate the value of a full harvester.
